value: Approximate Black-Scholes LEAPS without short call overlay using Yahoo adjusted close and trailing realized volatility
RSI(14) < 35 with tiered VIX entry filters
mean+1std <= VIX < mean+2std -> buy 1 contract max once per week, exits <12m +120%, 12-15m +60%, 16-18m +30%
first RSI<35 and VIX >= mean+2std signal in the last 60 trading days -> buy 1 contract, exits <12m +150%, 12-15m +80%, 16-18m +30%
second or later RSI<35 and VIX >= mean+2std signal in the last 20 trading days -> buy 2 contracts, or 1 if cash only covers one, exits <12m +150%, 12-15m +80%, 16-18m +30%
if a sigma2 day is not the first sigma2 signal in the last 60 trading days and also not the second-or-later sigma2 signal in the last 20 trading days, no sigma2 entry is taken
not applicable because short call overlay is disabled
force exit LEAPS at 180 days to expiry
start with $20000 and do not add capital later
sigma1 requires enough cash for 1 contract; sigma2 repeat buys 2 if possible, otherwise 1 if cash covers one contract; otherwise the signal is skipped
